_note: Material names, grades, caps and trader families live in elitelab/core/engineering.json. Only farming hints live here.

_general: Material Traders convert within a category: 6:1 down a grade, 3:1 up... in practice trade DOWN from a surplus high grade to fill low grades, and trade UP only when desperate. Find the nearest trader on Inara (Nearest > Material trader).
Raw: crystal shard forests and brain trees on specific planets give G4 raw fast; surface prospecting with an SRV for the rest.

Manufactured G5: High Grade Emission signal sources in systems with the matching state (Outbreak = Pharmaceutical Isolators, Civil Unrest = Improvised Components, War/Civil War = Military Supercapacitors / Military Grade Alloys, Boom = Proto Heat Radiators / Proto Radiolic Alloys, Empire = Imperial Shielding, Federation = Core Dynamics Composites). Relog to respawn.
Manufactured G1-G4: Dav's Hope (Hyades Sector DR-V c2-23, A 5) settlement relog loop in an SRV.
Encoded: Jameson Crash Site (HIP 12099, 1 B) for high grade encrypted/firmware data; scan private data beacons and high-energy wakes at busy stations for wake data.
